name: Acquisition Matrix Size
description: Validates that the acquired matrix dimensions fall within a configurable range (checked before reconstruction/interpolation).
implementation:
# AcquisitionMatrix format: [freq_rows, freq_cols, phase_rows, phase_cols]
# Non-zero values indicate the actual dimensions
acq_matrix = value["AcquisitionMatrix"].iloc[0]
if acq_matrix is not None and len(acq_matrix) >= 4:
    freq_dim = acq_matrix[0] if acq_matrix[0] > 0 else acq_matrix[1]
    phase_dim = acq_matrix[2] if acq_matrix[2] > 0 else acq_matrix[3]
    matrix_min_found = min(freq_dim, phase_dim)
    matrix_max_found = max(freq_dim, phase_dim)
    lo = params.get("matrix_min")
    hi = params.get("matrix_max")
    if (lo is not None and matrix_min_found < lo) or (hi is not None and matrix_max_found > hi):
        raise ValidationWarning(f"Acquired matrix should be within {lo:g}-{hi:g}. Found {freq_dim}x{phase_dim}.")

parameterDefinitions.name: matrix_min
parameterDefinitions.label: Minimum matrix size
parameterDefinitions.description: Warn if the smaller acquired dimension is below this

parameterDefinitions.name: matrix_max
parameterDefinitions.label: Maximum matrix size
parameterDefinitions.description: Warn if the larger acquired dimension is above this
